description: Pause (until a date, or until resumed), resume or cancel a subscription, or change its bag count, Job notes, or detergent and scent. Canceling also cancels its upcoming pickups. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

bagCount.description: Bags every pickup has, extra ones included (extras cost more)

jobNotes.description: Job notes for every pickup; blank clears them

pausedUntil.description: With pause: pickups start again on this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

detergent.description: free_clear is fragrance-free, and takes no scent

wash.description: Detergent and scent; null goes back to their Laundry preferences
